strategies.title: Buy and hold
strategies.plain: Put the money in on day one and never take it out.

strategies.title: Golden cross
strategies.plain: Stay in while prices are on a long climb. Move to cash when the climb ends.
strategies.rule: Long when the 50-day average is above the 200-day average.
strategies.citation: Murphy, J. J. (1999). Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets. New York Institute of Finance.

strategies.title: MACD crossover
strategies.plain: Stay in while prices are speeding up. Move to cash when they slow down.
strategies.rule: Long when MACD(12, 26) is above its 9-day signal line.
strategies.citation: Appel, G. (2005). Technical Analysis: Power Tools for Active Investors. FT Prentice Hall.

strategies.title: Bollinger bounce
strategies.plain: Jump in after an unusually sharp drop. Get out once the price is back to normal.
strategies.rule: Enter when the close falls below the lower band (20 days, 2 standard deviations). Exit when the close reaches the middle band.
strategies.citation: Bollinger, J. (2001). Bollinger on Bollinger Bands. McGraw-Hill.
